scope: Geographic dry-woodland pilot only; accepted reference and other biomes unchanged
reviewer: Implementing assistant; actual concept, 640x360 hero and inspection images inspected; no independent reviewer

diagnosis.visible: Repeated comb-like leaf arrangements and fragmented crown lighting
diagnosis.cause: Flat compound-spray geometry and repeated orientation; replacement shape quality uncertain

diagnosis.visible: Very dark limbs and uniformly warm floor
diagnosis.cause: Dark bark albedo under crown shadows; large soil fields carry little vegetation pigment

diagnosis.visible: A compact stand surrounded by bare terrain in inspection
diagnosis.cause: Location-specific matte correctly withheld, but no procedural stand continuation replaces it

rounds.hypothesis: Rounded dimensional sprays reduce serrated repetition; new source-baked distance patches fill the unsupported background.
rounds.decision: Reject foliage thinning and orange grass recoloring. Distance coverage improves but remains too isolated.

rounds.hypothesis: Overlapping larger sprays restore volume, denser patch layers connect woodland, and world-space ground fields integrate their bases.
rounds.decision: Reject canopy: flat foliage plates and about 5.1M submitted triangles. Retain the direction of woodland continuation and ground integration.

rounds.hypothesis: Restoring the best-known foliage while retaining supported distance/ground corrections preserves the stronger near scene.
rounds.decision: Retain partially. Improved elevated continuation and ground breakup; only modest change at hero height. Do not claim concept fidelity.

implementation: Source-baked four-patch 1024x1024 atlas from actual unnamed near trees; layered world-space cylindrical instances
Seventy-metre exclusion around the encounter camera keeps distance geometry out of staging
Continuous textured soil/low-cover pigment relationships on terrain; no floating ground stamps
Readable bark albedo floor and reduced directional shadow strength confined to pilot
Original foliage geometry, normals and grass pigments restored after rejected trials

metrics.mobile: Not measured on physical mobile hardware. Source-baked atlas has a one-time render cost and a 4 MiB RGBA color attachment estimate, plus depth/driver overhead.

remaining: Canopy geometry remains visibly repetitive and branches retain overly dark regions. A new representation needs a separately scoped tree study.
Hero-view improvement is modest; this pass does not meet the concept-quality target.
Distant cards approximate elevated views and can reveal repeated silhouettes; synthetic distribution is not measured habitat.
Only Costa Rica seed29 was visually evaluated during this pass; other pilot sites remain unreviewed.

rules.principle: Extend unsupported backgrounds using actual scene-source geometry rather than importing unrelated landscape assets
rules.limit: Partially successful here; not approved globally

rules.principle: More leaf geometry does not establish canopy quality

next: Human review of retained distance changes; isolate the remaining canopy representation problem before another environment pass.
